name: DigiCo SYD1 Data Centre Expansion
developer: HDI SYD1 Property Holdings Pty Limited / DigiCo
notes: NSW Planning Portal SSD-69637456 for Ultimo/Pyrmont in City of Sydney; approved determination for expansion of existing data centre including two additional levels and increased power consumption of 47.5 MW.

name: 22 O'Riordan Street, Alexandria Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning Portal SSD-77274467 in Prepare EIS for City of Sydney; construction and operation of a 38 MW data centre at 22 O'Riordan Street, Alexandria. DCD identified Markham as the filer in November 2024.

name: Equinix SY5 Sydney Data Centre
notes: Operator listing for SY5 at Unit B, 200 Bourke Road, Alexandria, Sydney NSW 2015; 4,948 m2 / 53,260 ft2 colocation space with N+1 power redundancy. Public page does not state MW capacity.

name: LEDC TMW1 Tamworth Data Centre
notes: Operator page lists TMW1 in Tamworth NSW with 375 kW total site capacity, 290 m2 available and Tier III design; NSW Government Invest Regional profile says LEDC operates an interconnected regional NSW Tier III network including Tamworth.

name: Brookhollow Avenue Data Centre Expansion, Norwest
notes: NSW Planning Portal SSD-81928961 for The Hills Shire shows Response to Submissions for construction and operation of an expansion to an existing data centre at 3 Brookhollow Avenue, Norwest. Urban Digest reports a 51,867 sqm site/GFA; Sydney Development Journal reported GreenSquare plans and about 80 MW full build-out capacity.

name: Alterations and Additions to Existing Data Centre, 3 Brookhollow Avenue Norwest
notes: Sydney Central City Planning Panel DA 1382/2025/JP for 3 Brookhollow Avenue, Norwest was approved on 2025-09-04 with capital investment value of A$84.7m. Sydney Development Journal describes this as Stage 1 upgrades raising the existing centre from 4 MW to 14.9 MW.
